finding.statement: Forge replay identity on current main is stable against observation-envelope mutation, but measured_packet still carries evaluated_at. Two fresh Distillery rebuilds can therefore emit different training-bearing packet bytes/token counts for the same stable measured execution when first observation timestamps differ.
finding.consumer_search: No separate measured_packet consumer was found; repository search resolves the helper to the canonical Forge-to-Distillery ingest path.
finding.parallel_change_guard: tools/ingest_forge_accepts_into_distillery.py has identical blob 316a2e63b329a2b1c7523c3a5b918349a12dd82f at PR1726 base cc2f4d57a6277e4a4452de9b4f0a7ccc17d4b9cf and current main fc45471f0eb61da17191a9f4a5edae7e184a1346.

hypothesis: Removing observation time from the training-bearing measured packet while retaining it as provenance metadata makes replay-equivalent fresh rebuilds byte/token stable without weakening execution identity or measured-evidence conflict detection.
counterhypothesis: Removing evaluated_at from CLAY_DISTILLERY_FORGE_EXECUTION_PACKET/v2 could break a separate consumer that treats observation time as measured training evidence.
counterhypothesis_disposition: NOT_SUPPORTED_BY_REPOSITORY_SEARCH; no separate measured_packet consumer was found. Runtime execution is still required before component promotion.

semantics: measured_evidence_identity wraps the same replay-stable measured_packet preimage
fresh replay-equivalent rebuilds are defined to require identical packet bytes, ids, digests and accepted token counts
